CREATE TABLE package_info (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    package_key TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    engine INT NOT NULL DEFAULT -1,
    size INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    md5 TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    content_type INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    content BLOB,
    content_file_path TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    reuse_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    run_time_type INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    UNIQUE(package_key)
)

CREATE TABLE `scene_info`
(
    id                           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    uid         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
    scene_key         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    strategy_key      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    user_relate BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    UNIQUE(uid, scene_key, strategy_key)
)

CREATE TABLE strategy_action_info (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    strategy_key TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    action_type INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1,
    action_param TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    action_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
)

CREATE TABLE strategy_info (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    strategy_key TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    package_key TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    UNIQUE(strategy_key, package_key)
)

CREATE TABLE stream_info (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    scene_key TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    strategy_key TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    stream_key TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    options TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    UNIQUE(scene_key, strategy_key, stream_key)
)
CREATE INDEX index_scene ON scene_info ( uid , strategy_key )
CREATE INDEX index_stream ON stream_info (scene_key, strategy_key)
